duplication_audit.novel_axis: past-only natural-time ordering of normalized increment energy
duplication_audit.distinction: v37 encodes horizontal-visibility graph topology, v39 sample entropy encodes template recurrence, v53 realized variation encodes jump magnitude, v57 LZ and v69 SAX encode symbolic complexity, and v66 encodes record events. v77 instead assigns squared-increment energy to normalized event order and measures natural-time variance, entropy, reversed entropy and their causal-order difference. It is not a spectrum, pole, codifference, pairwise-causality estimator, or reuse of prior outputs.
duplication_audit.repository_negative_fingerprint: No executed P3 natural-time, kappa1, natural-time entropy, S_rev, or increment-energy event-order feature contract was found.
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: official feedback is excluded from features, gates, model fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: past-only hs/tp/hmax/wspd on the native context, linearly filled within the observed prefix and sampled on the fixed 20-minute grid
encoder.event_energy: Q_k=(x_k-x_{k-1})^2; uniform event weights only when total Q is exactly numerically zero
encoder.natural_time: chi_k=k/N for the N increment-energy events; p_k=Q_k/sum(Q)

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Varotsos, Sarlis, Skordas, and Lazaridou, Entropy in the natural time domain, Physical Review E 70, 011106 (2004)
primary_sources.use: natural-time entropy motivation only; no P3 performance claim
